hook: Some couples do not receive parcels. They give statements.
reader_identity_mirror: Couples who both defend tiny unnecessary online orders will recognize themselves quickly.
emotional_obstacle: The small fear is judgment: each person wants their harmless indulgence understood instead of audited.
aachu_proof: She shields a parcel and says it was necessary with full confidence.
zuv_active_role: He opens his own parcel and says it is for work, then joins the hiding instead of judging her.
bridge: The second doorbell turns two separate defenses into one shared conspiracy.
earned_ending: Maybe love is one shared alibi.
send_save_reason: A viewer can send this to the partner who also has a perfectly serious explanation for every package.

stage_scene_gate.silent_panel_read: Boxes arrive, both defend themselves, another box exposes the pattern, both freeze, both hide the evidence, both become one team.
required_visible_actions: quiet payoff with both boxes half-hidden
stage_scene_gate.hard_rule: Text completes the scene; text must not carry the scene.
